messages:
Anna L: Heads up — RFC review sync next Tue 9am PT is showing up for me as 1am for EU folks. Did anyone else see this?

Chris P: Yep, seen it. Recurring event probably tied to organizer tz. Jess said yesterday a few folks got calendar notifications at the wrong hour. :eyes:

Sam K: Also noticed the Zoom link rotated on the invite again. Looks like the meeting is set to 'generate new link for each occurrence'. OpsBot posted a new meeting id overnight.

OpsBot: [automated] Zoom meeting ID for event 'RFC Review' changed to 987-654-321 (new link).

Miles R: Reminder — DST week will make recurrences shift for CET folks if event tz = PT. Best practice is to set the event timezone explicitly on the event (edit event > time zone) so the recurrence keeps wall-clock time across DST.

Jess W: Quick suggestion: run a 2-min poll for time slots that keep CET folks between 16:00-18:00 CET. And let's decide if we want a static Zoom PMI or not. PMIs avoid rotation but have tradeoffs.

Anna L: +1 to poll. I can toggle Zoom to PMI, but need calendar owner / PM rights to change meeting settings. :thumbsup:

Chris P: I'll post a Polly in #eng with 3 options: Tue 9am PT / Tue 11am PT / Wed 8am PT. Also I'll add explicit UTC times to the event description so clients/people in other tzs see it clearly.

Sam K: How-to note: when editing a recurring GCal event, click the timezone selector next to the date and set both start and recurrence tz explicitly. Otherwise GCal will re-interpret future occurrences incorrectly. Also check Zoom setting 'Generate new link for each occurrence' and uncheck if we want a stable link.

Jess W: If we go PMI, let's rotate the PMI passcode quarterly. PMIs are convenient for internal-only invites; not great for wider audiences.

Miles R: If poll picks a time that favors one region always, propose rotating meeting times quarterly to share pain.

Anna L: Ok — Chris, can you post the Polly and then temporarily turn off link rotation until we finalize? I'll re-issue invites after we pick a slot.

Chris P: Polly posted: https://polly.example/abc123 — also updated calendar description with explicit ISO/UTC times and a note: 'verify next occurrence 24h prior; if link changed ping @eng-platform'. I did NOT toggle PMI yet, leaving it off until we decide.

Jess W: Thanks. I'll double-check the calendar owner settings and help reissue invites once we pick a time.

Sam K: One extra tip — when you re-create the recurring event, set the organizer to a shared team account (eg: eng-calendar@redwood) so personal tz/PMI settings don't sneak back in.

Anna L: Perfect. We'll reconvene after poll. Thanks all.
